About RAVIE
◉

Building ideas for the aerospace future.

RAVIE is focused on exploring emerging aerospace technologies and developing ideas that can contribute to the future of flight.

Our approach connects scientific research with engineering, experimentation, and practical development.

From unmanned aerial systems and rotorcraft to advanced aerospace concepts, RAVIE aims to explore possibilities beyond conventional boundaries.

Our Vision
◎

To explore what comes next.

RAVIE envisions a future where aerospace research, advanced technologies, and innovative engineering come together to create safer, smarter, and more capable aerospace systems.

Our Mission
⌁

Research. Innovate. Execute.

To advance aerospace science and engineering through research, validation, innovation, and the development of next-generation aircraft, rotorcraft, unmanned aerial vehicles, and space exploration systems.

The RAVIE Approach

From research to real-world possibilities.

RAVIE connects scientific thinking, aerospace engineering, innovation, and disciplined execution. The objective is not simply to imagine future technologies, but to investigate the principles, challenges, and opportunities behind them.


Our interests span UAV and UAS technologies, rotorcraft, aircraft safety, aerospace systems, advanced flight concepts, and emerging aerospace technologies.

Research Areas

Exploring the Aerospace Frontier.

RAVIE's research interests focus on technologies capable of shaping the future of flight and aerospace systems.

UAV / UAS

UAV/UAS represents our focus on unmanned aerial systems and technologies. We explore the design, safety, reliability, autonomy and practical applications of unmanned aircraft systems, with an emphasis on developing future-ready aerospace solutions.

Rotorcraft

Rotorcraft represents our focus on rotary-wing aerospace systems, including helicopters and other vertical flight technologies. We explore their design, safety, reliability, performance and future capabilities, with an emphasis on practical engineering solutions for safer and more efficient flight.

Aircraft Safety

Aircraft Safety represents our focus on RAVIE safety challenges across aircraft systems, operations and the human element, with the objective of identifying risks, understanding their root causes and developing practical engineering solutions that improve safety, reliability, and operational resilience.

Aerospace Systems

Aerospace Systems represents our focus on the integrated technologies and engineering that enable flight and space operations, including design, integration, safety, reliability, performance and future development, to create practical and advanced aerospace applications.

Future Technologies

Future Technologies represents our focus on emerging technologies that can shape the next generation of aviation and aerospace. We explore advanced concepts, new engineering approaches, intelligent innovative technologies with the potential to improve safety, reliability, performance, and the capabilities of future aerospace systems.

The Future Starts With Research

Think Beyond The Horizon.

RAVIE is exploring new possibilities in aerospace, technology, research, and innovation. This is the beginning of a long-term journey toward the future of aerospace.
